description.ja: Mistral AIの音声入力モデル。2025年7月公開。Mistral Small 3に最先端の音声入力機能を追加。音声文字起こし、翻訳、音声理解に優れる。テキスト性能を維持しつつ音声機能を統合。
description.en: Mistral AI's audio input model. Released July 2025. Adds state-of-the-art audio input capabilities to Mistral Small 3. Excels at transcription, translation, and audio understanding. Integrates audio while maintaining text performance.

description.en: Lightweight audio model. For edge deployment.
